name: Modal (web component)
summary: The modal as a framework-free element, for code that cannot load the antd Modal: a white dialog over a dimmed mask with a title, a scrolling body and Cancel and OK buttons, capped to the viewport.
highlights: Same look as the antd Modal, no antd needed
Esc, mask and ✕ close it; focus trapped and returned
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-modal>, that reproduces the antd Modal as themed by modalTheme value for value: the white dialog with radius 8 and 20/24 padding, the 18px SemiBold ink title with the shared dismiss ✕ on its first line, the 14/22 body, Cancel and OK at 36 high on the right, the dimmed mask and the DS size cap (simple 504 · 75vh, complexity 720 · 80vh, rich 1280 · 90vh, never wider than the viewport less 32). It exists for apps that are dropping antd (the Manage app) and for pages that never load it: Vue 2 apps that only take <aha-*> elements and plain HTML. Its attributes follow the antd Modal props one for one (okText → ok-text, okButtonProps.disabled → ok-disabled, okButtonProps.danger → ok-danger, confirmLoading → confirm-loading, maskClosable → mask-closable, keyboard, closable, width), so a migration is a rename. The antd Modal with modal-theme.js stays the choice in React and Vue 3 apps that keep antd.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the render is identical in React, Vue and plain HTML. The element does not own its state: set or remove `open`. OK emits a cancelable `ok`; Cancel, ✕, Escape and the mask emit a cancelable `cancel` (detail.source); unless cancelled either goes on to the cancelable `close`, then the modal closes and emits `closed`. For an async OK, preventDefault() the `ok`, set `confirm-loading`, and remove `open` when the work resolves; keep it open and show an inline Alert when it fails (overlays C5, C6). React 18 has no custom-element event props: bind `ok`, `cancel` and `closed` through a ref with addEventListener, pass booleans as `attr={flag ? '' : undefined}` (React 18 writes `false` as the string "false", which the element also reads as off), and write the kebab-case attribute names. The antd props map: okText → ok-text, cancelText → cancel-text, okButtonProps={{ disabled }} → ok-disabled, {{ danger }} → ok-danger, {{ loading }} or confirmLoading → confirm-loading, footer={…} → children with slot="footer", footer={null} → no-footer, maskClosable={false} → mask-closable="false", keyboard={false} → keyboard="false", closable={false} → closable="false", width → width, onOk / onCancel → the `ok` / `cancel` events, afterClose → `closed`. There is no imperative confirm(); render the element.

spec.label: Dialog
spec.value: white (bg-elevated), radius 8, padding 20 24, the antd modal shadow (0 6 16 0 ink 8%, 0 3 6 -4 ink 12%, 0 9 28 8 ink 5%); 100 from the top of the viewport (10vh on a short one), or vertically centred with `centered`

spec.label: Size
spec.value: size="simple" (default) 504 wide · 75vh, "complexity" 720 · 80vh, "rich" 1280 · 90vh; `width` overrides the width (a bare number is px); never wider than the viewport less 16 each side, never taller than the cap: past it the body scrolls while the title and footer stay put

spec.label: Title
spec.value: 18/27 SemiBold ink, 8 above the body; the shared dismiss ✕ (tertiary icon-only xs aha-button, system-x 16) pinned to its first line, 8 from the title; `closable="false"` hides the ✕

spec.label: Body
spec.value: 14/22 ink, scrolls on its own past the cap and becomes a Tab stop only then; scroll does not chain to the page

spec.label: Footer
spec.value: 12 above, right aligned, 8 between: Cancel (secondary) then OK (primary), both md (36 high); `ok-danger` swaps them to Cancel primary and OK secondary (overlays C7); `slot="footer"` replaces both buttons, `no-footer` drops the footer

spec.label: Busy
spec.value: `confirm-loading`: OK shows its spinner and ignores clicks; Cancel and ✕ are disabled and Escape and the mask do nothing (overlays C2)

spec.label: Mask
spec.value: the overlay colour (ink at 40%), fades in over 0.3s; a click cancels unless `mask-closable="false"` or `ok-danger`

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: the dialog zooms from 0.2 and fades in over 0.3s, the mask fades over 0.3s; prefers-reduced-motion switches both off

spec.label: Behaviour
spec.value: role dialog, aria-modal, named by the title (or `label`); traps Tab, locks page scroll, returns focus to whatever opened it; Escape cancels unless `keyboard="false"`; Esc and Tab leave an open popup inside the modal (aha-select, aha-dropdown, aha-menu, aha-popover, an expanded combobox) and another dialog stacked over it to handle their own keys

props.name: open
props.desc: Shows the modal. Removing it hides it and emits `closed`

props.name: heading
props.desc: The title (antd `title`). Fill `slot="title"` instead for rich content

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name; overrides the title as the name

props.name: ok-text
props.desc: OK button label. Name the action ("Delete team"), not OK

props.name: cancel-text
props.desc: Cancel button label

props.name: ok-disabled
props.desc: Disables OK (antd okButtonProps.disabled)

props.name: ok-danger
props.desc: A destructive confirmation: OK secondary, Cancel primary, a mask click never closes it

props.name: confirm-loading
props.desc: OK shows its spinner; Cancel, ✕, Escape and the mask do nothing while set

props.name: size
props.desc: The DS tier: 504 · 75vh, 720 · 80vh or 1280 · 90vh

props.name: width
props.desc: Dialog width; a bare number is px. Wins over the size's width, never wider than the viewport less 32

props.name: centered
props.desc: Centres the dialog vertically

props.name: closable
props.desc: `closable="false"` hides the ✕

props.name: close-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the ✕

props.name: mask-closable
props.desc: `mask-closable="false"` ignores a click on the mask

props.name: keyboard
props.desc: `keyboard="false"` ignores Escape

props.name: no-footer
props.desc: Drops the footer (antd footer={null})

props.name: contained
props.desc: Centres it in the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, keeps the trap

props.name: inline
props.desc: Static display inside a positioned ancestor: no trap, no scroll lock, no keys. For docs and previews

props.name: slot="footer"
props.desc: Replaces Cancel and OK with your own buttons

props.name: slot="title"
props.desc: Rich title content instead of `heading`

props.name: close()
props.desc: Asks to close: emits `close` (source method), closes unless cancelled

props.name: ok
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. OK was pressed; unless cancelled the modal closes

props.name: cancel
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. detail.source is cancel-button, close-button, escape or mask; unless cancelled the modal closes

props.name: close
props.desc: Cancelable, composed. Fires before any close; detail.source is ok, cancel-button, close-button, escape, mask or method

props.name: closed
props.desc: Composed. The modal is closed; detail.source as on `close`, or attribute when `open` was removed directly

whenToUse.when: a short, blocking decision or task on a page that does not load antd or is dropping it: the Manage app, Vue 2 apps taking <aha-*>, plain HTML
a React or Vue 3 app that keeps antd and themes it with modal-theme.js
a longer edit form or detail panel that keeps page context

opinion.note: Name the OK button the action and phrase a confirmation title as a question. A destructive confirmation sets `ok-danger`, so Cancel is the primary and a stray mask click cannot confirm it. For async work, cancel the `ok` event, set `confirm-loading`, and close only once the work succeeds; show a failure inline in the body. Never hand-draw a dialog with a fixed div: the trap, the scroll lock and the focus return come with the element.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the inline, open example with the DS defaults.
conformance.measure: (function(){var r=document.querySelector('aha-modal[data-probe]').shadowRoot;function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var p=cs(r.querySelector('.panel'));var t=cs(r.querySelector('.title'));var b=cs(r.querySelector('.body'));var f=cs(r.querySelector('.footer'));var m=cs(r.querySelector('.mask'));return{surface:p.backgroundColor,radius:p.borderTopLeftRadius,padTop:p.paddingTop,padSide:p.paddingLeft,titleColor:t.color,titleSize:t.fontSize,titleWeight:t.fontWeight,titleLine:t.lineHeight,bodySize:b.fontSize,bodyLine:b.lineHeight,footerGap:f.marginTop,mask:m.backgroundColor,role:r.querySelector('.panel').getAttribute('role'),modal:r.querySelector('.panel').getAttribute('aria-modal')};})()
